name: operations
description: Deployment and Operation: the profile's deploy check, release, smoke and rollback on the base, and the retro over an intent (docs/design/operations.md).

messages.releaseUsage: usage: aidlc release <intent>, for a merged intent with deploy.run or release in the profile
messages.releaseCiNotGreen: {{intent}} ships only a pushed base whose CI passed (now: {{ci}}): run aidlc push and aidlc ci wait first
messages.releaseNoCheck: {{intent}} has no passing deploy check on this base: run aidlc deploy check {{intent}} first
messages.rollbackUsage: usage: aidlc rollback <intent>, for a merged or released intent
messages.deployUsage: usage: aidlc deploy check <intent>, for a merged intent with deploy.check in the profile
messages.deployNotMerged: {{intent}} is {{state}}: deploy steps run on a merged intent
messages.deployNotOnBase: check out {{base}} first: deploy steps run on the base
messages.retroUsage: usage: retro I-<n> (an intent in the bundle)
messages.retroSentBack: {{unit}} sent back at {{at}}: no test tagged {{tags}}
messages.retroDenials: {{count}} repeated hook denials escalated to the owner
messages.retroProposals: proposals (the owner accepts or rejects each):
messages.retroGlob: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: add the folders where its tests live to profile.levels.<level>.paths
messages.retroScope: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: in .aidlc/rules/planning.md, scope each bolt to its tests, fixtures and generated files
messages.retroBuilder: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: in .aidlc/rules/builder.md, run the card's checks and test runs before the report
messages.retroTemplate: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: in .aidlc/templates/, give the doc template what {{key}} asks for
messages.retroLead: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: in .aidlc/rules/lead.md, write down the command the lead should use instead
messages.retroMerge: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: in .aidlc/rules/lead.md, run aidlc merge only when aidlc next offers it
messages.retroStop: builders stopped {{count}} times: in .aidlc/rules/planning.md, name the interfaces and folders a bolt needs before approval
messages.retroReviewCheck: reviews escalated {{count}} times: a profile check (modules[].check or architecture.checks) that catches what the reviewers found
messages.retroCheck: {{key}} fired {{count}} times: a profile check (modules[].check or architecture.checks) that catches it before review

commands.name: retro
commands.does: list what fired, escalated and needed the owner; propose at most three changes; reset the counters

commands.name: deploy
commands.does: run the profile's deploy check on the base and record it

commands.name: release
commands.does: run deploy.run and the profile's release on the base, then deploy.smoke, and record them (the owner's)

commands.name: rollback
commands.does: run deploy.rollback and record it (the owner's)
